metadata.name: launchpad_program
metadata.description: LIMITLESS launchpad — Token-2022 native, forever-revenue for creators

instructions.name: abort_meteora_preparation
docs: Anyone: recover staging rent to the complete curve awaiting graduation.

instructions.name: admin_close_orphan_pda
docs: Admin escape hatch: close a whitelisted orphan PDA and sweep its
rent to a specified destination. Only PDAs whose seed is on the
hardcoded `ORPHAN_SEED_WHITELIST` and whose balance is below
`ORPHAN_CLOSE_DUST_THRESHOLD` can be closed through this path.

accounts.name: orphan_pda
docs: (seeds under our `program_id`), so lamport mutation via
`try_borrow_mut_lamports` is safe. Seed membership + balance
threshold are enforced by the handler.

accounts.name: destination
docs: Lamport destination. Restrict this to a system-owned account so an
admin typo cannot strand recovered funds in a program-owned or
executable account.

instructions.name: approve_legacy_bonding_fees
docs: Jointly attest bounded entitlements in an escrow for our funding PDA.

instructions.name: approve_legacy_rewards
docs: Joint approval by source admin and a distinct program upgrade authority.

instructions.name: buy
docs: Buy tokens off the bonding curve. Charges the bonding-curve fee
and routes splits into platform / creator / rewards escrows.

accounts.name: charity_wallet
docs: any account may be passed (sentinel — no transfer runs). When
non-zero, must match `launched_coin.charity_wallet`.

instructions.name: claim_bonding_fee_escrow
docs: Recover deferred bonding fees to a safe destination authorized by their beneficiary.

instructions.name: claim_legacy_bonding_fees
docs: Pay an attested legacy escrow entitlement directly to its signing beneficiary.

instructions.name: claim_legacy_rewards
docs: Pay only the beneficiary and amount authenticated by an immutable ledger.

instructions.name: claim_meteora_fees
docs: Claim perpetual DAMM pool fees to the immutable receipt's recipient.

accounts.name: recipient
docs: optional and only permits withdrawing positive amounts below the minimum.

instructions.name: claim_meteora_transfer_fees
docs: Legacy withdrawal for launchpad-authority mints from the earlier Meteora
implementation. New mints use the fee splitter before/after graduation.

accounts.name: recipient
docs: optional and only permits withdrawing positive amounts below the minimum.

instructions.name: create_and_first_buy
docs: Launch a new Token-2022 mint AND execute a mandatory first buy in
one atomic transaction, with the buyer paying rent and SOL.
Creator and fee-recipient signatures are optional, matching live calls.
Their presence records consent without changing launch authorization.

accounts.name: buyer
docs: Pays rent for every `init` and every CPI-created account below.
Signs the first buy as the token recipient.

accounts.name: creator
docs: Kept unchecked so the site's same-wallet launch needs no new signer meta.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The new Token-2022 mint. Caller generates a fresh keypair (or pulls
from the vanity pool on the backend) and signs for account
creation; no further authority is retained after this instruction.

accounts.name: vault_token_account
docs: Created via ATA CPI inside the handler; address is enforced by the
ATA program's own derivation. Same pattern as `launch_coin`.

accounts.name: genie_alloc_vault_authority
docs: pinned by seeds, holds no data, and only ever signs for the vault it
owns. Present even when `genie_allocation_bps == 0` so the account list
is the same shape for every launch.

accounts.name: genie_alloc_vault_token_account
docs: `genie_alloc_vault_authority`. Created via ATA CPI in the handler only
when an allocation was actually requested; the ATA program enforces the
derivation, and the handler asserts the owner before minting into it.

accounts.name: buyer_token_account
docs: inside the handler (after the mint is live) — Anchor's
`init_if_needed` can't handle this because the mint is created by
the handler, not upstream of account validation. Address is
enforced by the subsequent `transfer_checked` CPI.

accounts.name: creator_fee_recipient
docs: equal the creator or sign.

accounts.name: charity_wallet
docs: is `None` / `charity_bps == 0` any account may be passed (the
charity transfer doesn't run). When `Some`, must match.

instructions.name: create_or_buy_pda
docs: Additive mint-PDA entry point. Existing instruction ABIs are unchanged.

instructions.name: create_or_buy_pda_with_vanity_fee
docs: Paid address adapter; preserves the original create_or_buy_pda wire.

instructions.name: distribute_rewards
docs: Reserved candidate instruction; discretionary rewards withdrawals are disabled.

instructions.name: force_unmark_graduated
docs: Retired instruction: always fails; completed curves never reopen.

instructions.name: fund_genie_allocation
docs: Fund a Genie claim epoch from the allocation reserved at launch.

instructions.name: graduate
docs: Graduate a launched coin to Raydium CPMM. Moves remaining curve
liquidity into a new Token-2022-aware pool and flips
`LaunchedCoin.graduated = true`. After graduation, the only fee
flow is the Token-2022 `TransferFeeConfig` withholding, harvested
by the fee-splitter program.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone. Acts as Raydium's "creator" — pays pool-creation rent and
fronts the SOL/tokens that seed the pool. `launched_coin` lamports
(pump.fun-style in-PDA SOL reserves) and the curve's token vault
reimburse payer in-handler; net out-of-pocket is only Raydium's
pool-creation rent + tx fees.

accounts.name: vault_token_account
docs: Curve's mint vault — contributes bounded tokens to payer's ATA.

accounts.name: payer_token_ata
docs: Payer's mint ATA. Receives the curve's tokens pre-Raydium, then
Raydium's CPI drains it into `token_X_vault`.

accounts.name: payer_wsol_ata
docs: Payer's wSOL ATA. Holds the wrapped SOL that seeds the pool's
SOL side. Consumed by Raydium's CPI.

accounts.name: raydium_pool_state
docs: ["graduation_pool", mint] PDA, signed only by this program during CPI.

accounts.name: raydium_creator_token_0
docs: or payer_token_ata, depending on mint ordering).

instructions.name: graduate_limitless_swap
docs: Graduate a launched coin into a LIMITLESS Swap pool (our
Raydium-CPMM fork) instead of Raydium. Same asset flow as
`graduate`; with the pinned `create_pool_fee = 0` config the
caller's net cost is pool rent only (~0.008 SOL vs ~0.188 on
Raydium) and the graduated pool's fees stay inside LIMITLESS.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone. Plays the swap program's `creator` role — pays pool-creation
rent and fronts the SOL/tokens that seed the pool. With
`create_pool_fee = 0` the net out-of-pocket is rent + tx fees only
(~0.008 SOL vs ~0.188 on Raydium); `launched_coin` lamports reimburse
the seeded `sol_reserves` in-handler.

accounts.name: vault_token_account
docs: Curve's mint vault — contributes bounded tokens to payer's ATA.

accounts.name: payer_token_ata
docs: Payer's mint ATA. Receives the curve's tokens, then the swap CPI
drains it into `token_X_vault`.

accounts.name: payer_wsol_ata
docs: Payer's wSOL ATA. Holds the wrapped SOL that seeds the pool's SOL
side. Consumed by the swap CPI.

accounts.name: swap_amm_config
docs: `read_limitless_config` (owner + Anchor discriminator + typed
deserialize). Deliberately NOT `Account<'info, LimitlessAmmConfig>`:
the Raydium graduation already inlines raydium-cp-swap's `AmmConfig`
into this program's IDL, and Anchor refuses a second external type
of the same name — so this reads foreign state exactly the way
`graduate_meteora` reads DAMM accounts.

accounts.name: swap_pool_state
docs: PDA. Validated before funding; the protected PDA signs only during CPI.

accounts.name: swap_creator_token_0
docs: or payer_token_ata, depending on mint ordering).

accounts.name: swap_creator_lp_token
docs: post-CPI so graduation leaves no withdrawable LP position.

accounts.name: swap_create_pool_fee
docs: swap program's `initialize`. Pre-pinned here for a legible failure.

instructions.name: graduate_meteora
docs: Permissionless graduation of a threshold-met curve into a Meteora DAMM v2
pool with both fee positions permanently locked in program PDAs.

accounts.name: pool
docs: Reject occupancy before any rent/deposit, never adopt an existing pool.
https://github.com/MeteoraAg/damm-v2/blob/main/programs/cp-amm/src/instructions/initialize_pool/ix_initialize_pool_with_dynamic_config.rs

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Initialize the global `Config` PDA and `RewardsPool` PDA.
Must be called exactly once per deployment by the deploy keypair.
After this call, the `admin` field on `Config` governs all subsequent
admin-only instructions.

accounts.name: launchpad_program
docs: The executable launchpad account. Pairing it with `program_data`
prevents an arbitrary signer from winning the singleton Config PDA
race on a fresh deployment.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: Upgradeable-loader metadata for this exact program. Initialization is
authorized only while `admin` is the program upgrade authority.

instructions.name: initialize_bonding_fee_escrow
docs: Donate rent to a mint/recipient escrow so holder trades can defer an unsafe fee payment.

instructions.name: launch_coin
docs: Launch a new Token-2022 mint with `TransferFeeConfig` +
`MetadataPointer` + metadata extensions. Revokes the transfer-fee
config authority at mint creation so the post-graduation rate is
trustlessly immutable.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The new Token-2022 mint. Caller generates a fresh keypair, signs for
its creation, and has no further authority over it after this
instruction returns.

accounts.name: vault_token_account
docs: owned by `launched_coin`. Created via ATA CPI inside the handler;
address is enforced by the `create_associated_token_account`
instruction's own derivation.

accounts.name: creator_token_account
docs: Creator's token ATA. Passed as `UncheckedAccount` because Anchor's
`init_if_needed` runs at account-validation time, before the mint has
been created by the handler — the ATA program CPI would fail with
`InvalidMint`. Created explicitly inside the handler (after the mint
is live) via `associated_token::create_idempotent` if the atomic
first-buy branch runs. Address is pinned by the ATA program's own
derivation on the transfer CPI.
transfer_checked CPIs in the handler.

accounts.name: creator_fee_recipient
docs: or this recipient's signature, even without an optional first buy.

accounts.name: rewards_pool
docs: Rewards pool PDA.

accounts.name: charity_wallet
docs: is `None` this must equal `creator` (sentinel). When `Some`, must
match `params.charity_wallet.unwrap()`.

instructions.name: prepare_meteora_graduation
docs: Anyone: stage Meteora state for a permanently complete curve.
Repeated preparation is idempotent; completion may be retried.

accounts.name: pool
docs: Reject occupancy before any rent/deposit, never adopt an existing pool.
https://github.com/MeteoraAg/damm-v2/blob/main/programs/cp-amm/src/instructions/initialize_pool/ix_initialize_pool_with_dynamic_config.rs

instructions.name: sell
docs: Sell tokens back to the bonding curve. Same fee treatment as buy.

accounts.name: charity_wallet
docs: any account may be passed (sentinel — no transfer runs). When
non-zero, must match `launched_coin.charity_wallet`.

instructions.name: set_bonding_fee
docs: Retired: the live bonding fee cannot be changed by an admin.

instructions.name: set_bonding_shares
docs: Retired: live bonding fee shares cannot be changed by an admin.

instructions.name: set_graduation_operator
docs: Retired instruction: always fails; graduation has no operator role.

instructions.name: set_legacy_meteora_config
docs: Admin: store a legacy policy hint; existing curves need no admin selection.

accounts.name: meteora_config
docs: None clears selection only while the venue is disabled.

instructions.name: set_max_creator_first_buy_bps
docs: Config authority: update the atomic first-buy cap (0 disables, maximum 10000).

instructions.name: set_meteora_config
docs: Admin: select (or clear) a DAMM policy for new-launch admission.
Existing curves may graduate with any authenticated valid policy.

accounts.name: meteora_config
docs: None clears selection only while the venue is disabled.

instructions.name: set_meteora_graduation_enabled
docs: Admin: enable or disable Meteora admission for future launches only.
Preparation and completion of existing curves ignore this flag.

instructions.name: update_admin
docs: Admin: rotate the configuration key; grants no control over coin trading.

instructions.name: update_distribution_config
docs: Admin: update the platform-side fee distribution breakdown
(treasury / nft-rewards / lp-incentive / ecosystem). Must sum
to 10_000 bps. Applies to all future distributions.

instructions.name: update_graduation_threshold
docs: Admin: update the graduation threshold snapshotted by new launches.

instructions.name: update_graduation_venue_default
docs: Admin: update the default `graduation_venue` written onto new
`LaunchedCoin` accounts at `launch_coin` time. Does not retroactively
move existing launches — each launch keeps its own snapshot.

instructions.name: update_meteora_pool_fee
docs: Admin: Meteora pool fee policy for dynamic-fee configs, in tenths of a
basis point (1250 = 1.25%). Zero selects the 1.25% default.

instructions.name: update_swap_venue
docs: Retired: the pool pointer committed by graduation cannot be redirected.

accounts.name: pool
docs: authenticated before publishing the routing pointer.

errors.name: SettlementUnauthorized
errors.msg: settlement requires the source admin and a distinct program upgrade authority

errors.name: InvalidSettlement
errors.msg: invalid settlement source, kind, generation, root or liability total

errors.name: SettlementOutstanding
errors.msg: the previous immutable settlement still has unpaid entitlements

errors.name: EntitlementExceeded
errors.msg: claim exceeds the authenticated unpaid entitlement

errors.name: SettlementInsolvent
errors.msg: legacy source cannot fully back its liabilities and rent

types.name: AmmConfig
docs: Holds the current owner of the factory

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump to identify PDA

fields.name: disable_create_pool
docs: Status to control if new pool can be create

fields.name: index
docs: Config index

fields.name: trade_fee_rate
docs: The trade fee, denominated in hundredths of a bip (10^-6)

fields.name: protocol_fee_rate
docs: The protocol fee

fields.name: fund_fee_rate
docs: The fund fee, denominated in hundredths of a bip (10^-6)

fields.name: create_pool_fee
docs: Fee for create a new pool

fields.name: protocol_owner
docs: Address of the protocol fee owner

fields.name: fund_owner
docs: Address of the fund fee owner

fields.name: creator_fee_rate
docs: The pool creator fee, denominated in hundredths of a bip (10^-6)

fields.name: padding
docs: padding

fields.name: evidence_hash
docs: Digest of the exact historical allocation records reviewed by both
signers. Its authenticity comes from those attestations, not the caller.

types.name: BadgeTier
docs: Badge tier. Drives platform perks (homepage featuring, analytics access,
community badges) only — does NOT affect fee splits. Kept as `u8` so the
tier set can grow without breaking existing accounts.

types.name: BondingCurveType
docs: Bonding-curve shape discriminant. Kept as a field rather than hard-coded
so Milestone-2 can introduce new curve types (e.g. exponential, LBP).

types.name: BondingFeeEscrow
docs: Isolated SOL custody for an immutable fee beneficiary. Only the balance above
rent belongs to the beneficiary; initialization rent stays reserved so claims
cannot make traders fund it again. No curve reserves or other fees are shared.

fields.name: amount
docs: Claimed surplus only; initialization rent remains in the escrow.

fields.name: min_tokens_out
docs: Minimum tokens the buyer must actually *receive* (after the
Token-2022 transfer-fee withholding). Protects against slippage
and priced-out front-runs.

fields.name: path
docs: `0` on buy/sell paths (SOL), `1` on post-graduation distribute (tokens).

fields.name: accept_zero_net
docs: Token beneficiary explicitly accepts a transfer entirely withheld as
the mint's existing fee. Required to settle otherwise indivisible dust.
Never accepted for SOL and never inferred from a relayer's signature.

fields.name: graduation_venue
docs: `GraduationVenue as u8`. 0 = Raydium, 1 = LimitlessSwap.

fields.name: admin
docs: Admin key. Rotates via `update_admin`. Governs every admin-only
instruction on this program.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Destination for the platform's share of SOL fees.

fields.name: fee_splitter_program
docs: Program ID of the companion fee-splitter program. The launchpad
uses this to derive the `withdraw_withheld_authority` PDA at mint
creation time.

fields.name: standard_transfer_fee_bps
docs: Transfer fee applied to Standard / memecoin launches.

fields.name: shopify_transfer_fee_bps
docs: Transfer fee applied to Shopify-integrated launches.

fields.name: post_grad_creator_share_bps
docs: Creator share of harvested post-graduation transfer fees.

fields.name: post_grad_platform_share_bps
docs: Platform share of harvested post-graduation transfer fees.

fields.name: distribution
docs: Platform-side distribution of the platform's share.

fields.name: graduation_sol_threshold
docs: Default graduation trigger (lamports) applied to new launches.
Each launch snapshots this value into `LaunchedCoin` so later edits
don't change the bar for already-live launches.

fields.name: bump
docs: Canonical PDA bump.

fields.name: premium_transfer_fee_bps
docs: Transfer fee applied to Premium launches.

fields.name: trader_transfer_fee_bps
docs: Transfer fee applied to Trader-rewards launches.

fields.name: community_transfer_fee_bps
docs: Transfer fee applied to Community launches.

fields.name: max_creator_first_buy_bps
docs: Cap on a creator's first-buy amount in an atomic launch+buy,
expressed as a bps share of `total_supply`. 0 disables the cap.
Default: 500 bps (5%).

fields.name: first_buy_max_pct_of_supply
docs: Optional first-buy-as-share-of-supply cap in bps. Enforced on the
*first* trade only (when `cumulative_token_volume == 0`). 0 disables.

fields.name: is_paused
docs: RETIRED. The pause system was removed 2026-09-15 on founder order.
No instruction reads or writes this field; initialize writes false.
Kept solely to preserve the Config account layout for the upgrade.

fields.name: graduation_venue_default
docs: Default post-graduation venue snapshot written onto new
`LaunchedCoin` accounts at `launch_coin` time. Existing launches
keep their per-launch snapshot even if this default flips later.

fields.name: meteora_pool_fee_bps
docs: Meteora-only fee in tenths of a basis point despite the retained wire name.
1250 = 125 actual bps = 1.25%; zero selects this default.
Taken from reserved space; existing fields and account size stay fixed.

fields.name: meteora_graduation_enabled
docs: New-launch admission only; never gates existing curves' graduation.
Carved from legacy zero padding; never inferred from a build feature.

fields.name: meteora_config
docs: DAMM policy hint and new-launch admission; existing coins are not pinned.

fields.name: meteora_config_is_static
docs: Static policy fees come from DAMM, never update_meteora_pool_fee.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Forward-compatibility padding; bytes 0..37 retain legacy policy data.
The former graduation operator bytes are inert padding again.

fields.name: genie_allocation_bps
docs: Share of `total_supply` gifted to staked Genie holders, in basis
points. 0 = no allocation (behaviour identical to before this field
existed). Non-zero must be 100..=1000, i.e. 1%..10%. Curve supply,
LP headroom and virtual token offset scale proportionally.

fields.name: creator_fee_recipient
docs: Where the creator's share of trading fees lands. Usually equals
`creator` but supports a multisig / squad pubkey for brand launches.
This is an on-chain param (not derived from `creator.key()`) because
fee routing may legitimately differ from the creator identity. A
recipient other than the creator must sign the launch transaction.

fields.name: virtual_token_offset
docs: Pump.fun-parity virtual token offset. Pass
`STANDARD_VIRTUAL_TOKEN_OFFSET` for pump.fun-equivalent slope, `0`
for the legacy flat LIMITLESS curve.

fields.name: charity_wallet
docs: Optional charity wallet (system account). `None` = no overlay.

fields.name: charity_bps
docs: Charity share of total fees (bps). Ignored if `charity_wallet` is
`None`. Validated against `CHARITY_BPS_MAX`.

fields.name: first_buy_sol_amount
docs: Mandatory first-buy amount in lamports. Must be > 0 — the whole
point of this instruction is that rent is funded by the buy, so
a zero buy is a logic error at the client.

fields.name: first_buy_min_tokens_out
docs: Minimum tokens (post transfer-fee withhold) the buyer is willing
to receive. `0` means no slippage protection.

fields.name: graduation_sol_threshold_override
docs: Optional per-launch graduation trigger override. Same range rules
as `launch_coin`.

types.name: FeeDistributionConfig
docs: Platform-side distribution of the non-creator, non-rewards portion of
fees. Currently 100% treasury; the other slots are reserved so we can
shift share to NFT rewards, LP incentives, or an ecosystem fund without
a program upgrade.

types.name: GenieAllocationReserved
docs: Emitted when a launch reserves part of its supply for staked Genie holders.
`allocation_amount` is the EXACT number of tokens minted into the vault:
because this is a mint and not a transfer, no Token-2022 fee was withheld,
so the indexer can trust this figure without reading the vault balance.

types.name: GraduationVenue
docs: Post-graduation venue selector. Snapshot onto `LaunchedCoin` at launch
from `Config.graduation_venue_default` so later admin toggles don't
move in-flight launches to a different AMM.
**Backward-compat constraint:** `Raydium` MUST remain discriminant `0`.
Existing `LaunchedCoin` accounts from the pre-V2 binary have a zero
byte at the `graduation_venue` offset (it used to be part of
`reserved`). If `Raydium` weren't `0`, those accounts would fail
AnchorDeserialize.

fields.name: old_venue
docs: Previous `Config.graduation_venue_default` serialized as u8.

fields.name: new_venue
docs: New `Config.graduation_venue_default` serialized as u8.

fields.name: creator_fee_recipient
docs: Where the creator's share of fees should land. Usually the creator
wallet; a distinct recipient (including a multisig or squad) must sign.

fields.name: virtual_token_offset
docs: Pump.fun-parity virtual token offset. Caller chooses the value;
the default client path passes `STANDARD_VIRTUAL_TOKEN_OFFSET` for
a pump.fun-equivalent curve, `0` to reproduce the legacy LIMITLESS
flat curve. V2 drops the on-chain Standard-curve gate — callers
can tune the curve freely.

fields.name: charity_wallet
docs: Optional charity wallet (system account). `None` = no charity
overlay. When `Some`, `charity_bps` must be in `(0, CHARITY_BPS_MAX]`.

fields.name: charity_bps
docs: Charity share of total fees (bps). Ignored if `charity_wallet` is
`None`.

fields.name: first_buy_sol_amount
docs: If `Some(amount)`, the handler runs the creator's first buy atomically
after the mint is live. Capped by `Config.max_creator_first_buy_bps`.

fields.name: first_buy_min_tokens_out
docs: When `first_buy_sol_amount` is set, the minimum tokens (post-
transfer-fee) the creator is willing to receive. 0 = no slippage
check (creator signed the tx so they already accepted the price).

fields.name: graduation_sol_threshold_override
docs: Optional per-launch graduation trigger (lamports). `None` uses
`Config.graduation_sol_threshold`. When `Some(v)`, `v` must fall
within `[MIN_GRADUATION_SOL_THRESHOLD, MAX_GRADUATION_SOL_THRESHOLD]`
(1 SOL – 1000 SOL). The value is snapshotted onto `LaunchedCoin`
so later Config edits don't move the bar for this launch.

types.name: LaunchType
docs: Rust discriminants and historical Borsh ordinals differ: Premium/Trader/
Community serialize as 2/3/4. Preserve those bytes for existing accounts.
Do not reorder variants or reuse the retired Rust discriminants 2, 4 or 5.

fields.name: creator_fee_recipient
docs: Where the creator's share of fees is routed. May differ from
`creator` (e.g. a multisig or a squad).

fields.name: transfer_fee_bps
docs: Exact Token-2022 `TransferFeeConfig.transfer_fee_basis_points`
value written onto the mint at launch time. Locked in by the
revoke of `transfer_fee_config_authority`.

fields.name: preferred_swap_venue
docs: AMM pool account of the preferred post-graduation swap venue.
Committed atomically at graduation; no admin may change this pointer.

fields.name: graduation_sol_threshold
docs: Snapshot of the graduation trigger (lamports) taken at launch.
`graduate` fires when `sol_reserves >= graduation_sol_threshold`.
Stored per-launch so Config-level threshold changes don't move the
goalposts for in-flight launches.

fields.name: virtual_token_offset
docs: Pump.fun-style virtual token offset. Added to
`tokens_remaining_on_curve` when the constant-product curve computes
its `virtual_tokens_before`. Flattens the price curve so each SOL
buys more tokens. For a Standard launch this equals 280M × 10^6.
0 disables the offset (backward-compat with old LIMITLESS curve).

fields.name: charity_wallet
docs: Optional charity destination (system account). `Pubkey::default()`
means no charity overlay. Applies to both bonding-curve SOL fees
and post-graduation transfer-fee harvests.

fields.name: charity_bps
docs: Charity share of total fees in bps. 0–`CHARITY_BPS_MAX` (1_000 = 10%).
Carved out BEFORE the other shares split the remainder.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout-version tag. `0` = pre-V2 binary (field was zero inside
`reserved`), `1` = live V2, `2` = proportional allocation economics and explicit
consent marker in reserved[17]. Always increment when fields are added
to the end of the struct so migration code can branch on it.

fields.name: graduation_venue
docs: Post-graduation venue snapshot, taken at launch from
`Config.graduation_venue_default`. Immutable per-launch.
For version=0 accounts this deserializes as `Raydium` (zero byte).

fields.name: reserved
docs: Forward-compatibility padding. Shrunk from 78 → 76 to accommodate
the two V2 fields above.

fields.name: creator
docs: Creator fee recipient recorded in the graduation receipt.

fields.name: tokens_deposited
docs: Gross debit staged into the CPI; pool receives this net of mint transfer fee.

fields.name: pool_fee_bps
docs: Tenths of a basis point; numerator = value * 10_000 out of 1e9.

fields.name: creator_fee_recipient
docs: Immutable snapshot of LaunchedCoin::creator_fee_recipient; owns creator fee claims.

fields.name: pool_fee_bps
docs: Tenths of a basis point; numerator = value * 10_000 out of 1e9 (1250 = 1.25%).

fields.name: tokens_deposited
docs: Gross debit staged into the CPI; pool receives this net of mint transfer fee.

fields.name: creator_remainder
docs: Creator's unpaid fraction in ten-thousandths of one raw token unit.

types.name: PdaVanityFee
docs: Extra terms for a NEW paid PDA address. Existing PDA and keypair entrypoints
retain their exact wire and semantics. The fee is paid only by the creating
buyer, atomically with mint creation and purchase; racing normal buys do not
pay it again. A caller cannot omit it while retaining the reserved address.

types.name: ProgramPausedToggled
docs: Legacy event retained for IDL compatibility; no instruction emits it.

fields.name: accumulated_sol
docs: SOL currently held in the pool's rent-exempt lamport balance
minus the rent-exempt reserve. Tracked explicitly so rent
changes don't corrupt the accounting.

fields.name: total_distributed

fields.name: min_sol_out
